success_patterns: An affirmative reply to an explicit offer or proposal is an active request to carry it out, even when it adds no new filter.

patch.reasoning: Two trajectories show affirmative replies accepting a proposed next step. The current rule carries forward the proposal but does not explicitly require executing it, which can lead to a no-op when compatible results are already cached.

edits.target: - Resolve brief affirmations such as “yes” against the immediately preceding assistant question or proposal, and carry forward the proposed entity or category as stated.
edits.content: - Resolve brief affirmations such as “yes” against the immediately preceding assistant question or proposal, and carry forward the proposed entity or category as stated. Treat acceptance of an offer to provide recommendations or perform an action as an active request: fulfill the proposal, retrieving the closest compatible cached result when available or performing the proposed search or transformation otherwise. Do not treat acceptance as a no-op merely because it adds no new filter.
